source: 1217 藿藿 战技 灵符•保命护身 (121702, BPSkill/Restore): 「解除指定我方单体的1个负面效果，立即为指定我方单体回复等同于藿藿21.00%生命上限+560的生命值，同时为其相邻目标回复等同于藿藿16.80%生命上限+448的生命值。」
note: 「**解除指定我方单体的 1 个负面效果**」 — the cleanse half; the heal half is the engine's own `Restore` skill path (the row carries 21% max HP + 560). ⚠ `target` is the ally the Skill was aimed at (M-35), which is what 「指定我方单体」 names. ⚠ **Registered**: 「同时为其**相邻目标**回复…」 — the engine has no position axis, so "adjacent" cannot be said (the selector gap in GAPS #7).

source: 1217 藿藿 天赋 凭附•气通天真 (121704, Enhance/Restore) 强化前: 「施放战技后藿藿获得【禳命】，持续2回合，藿藿每回合开始时持续回合数减1。」
note: 「施放战技后藿藿获得【禳命】，持续 2 回合，**藿藿每回合开始时**持续回合数减 1」 — the state sits on her and runs on **her own** clock (`ticks_on: "self"`), which is the same field 8006's 【伴舞】 and 星期日's 【蒙福者】 use. ⚠ **Registered**: the 「**强化后**」 variant (3 turns, and the healing sentence itself changes) — a talent upgrade this engine has no way to select: it is not an eidolon (so `min_eidolon` is the wrong gate) and no trace spellings exist for it. Shipping the base version and registering the upgrade is the honest split; picking one and pretending it is both would apply a 3-turn state to every battle.

source: 1217 藿藿 终结技 尾巴•遣神役鬼 (121703, Ultra/Support): 「为除自身以外的队友恢复等同于各自20.00%能量上限的能量，同时使其攻击力提高40.00%，持续2回合。」
note: 「为**除自身以外**的队友恢复等同于**各自** 20.00% **能量上限**的能量，同时使其攻击力提高 40.00%，持续 2 回合」 — three spellings the engine already has: `other_allies` (「除自身以外的队友」), a **per-target** share of max energy (`GAIN_ENERGY` with `percent`, added for 星期日's ultimate), and a party-wide `MODIFY_ATTR` with a turn count. ⚠ 「**各自**」 is why the energy is a share of each recipient's own maximum rather than of hers — targeting that reads the *owner's* maximum would be a plausible-looking wrong number. ⚠ **2026-09-28 补齐**：回能那一半也已写出 —— `GAIN_ENERGY` 现在会遍历 `resolveTargets` 的每个候选，每人拿**各自**能量上限的 20%（这正是「各自」的意思；此前它只解析一个目标，所以被迫登记）。

source: 1217 藿藿 天赋 凭附•气通天真的触发部分: 「当藿藿拥有【禳命】时，我方目标回合开始…时回复自身等同于藿藿4.50%生命上限+120的生命值，同时对每个当前生命值百分比小于等于50%的我方目标各产生1次回复效果。触发【禳命】为我方目标提供治疗时，解除该目标1个负面效果。」
note: The trigger half of the talent. ⚠ 「藿藿拥有【禳命】时」 is `self has_state 禳命`: the **rule owner** carries the state while the event belongs to whoever's turn starts (that is what `self` means in this DSL, and it is the same shape 1001's counter-shield heal uses). ⚠ The heal's magnitude is 「等同于**藿藿** 4.50% 生命上限 + 120」 = `scale: owner_max_hp` — the rule owner's, not the recipient's, and the constant rides along in `amount`. ⚠ The third effect is 「对每个当前生命值百分比 ≤ 50% 的我方目标**各产生 1 次**」: `target_when` evaluates the filter per candidate, so `target_hp_percent` reads each candidate's own health. ⚠ It may heal the same unit twice (once as 「自身」, once if it is also ≤ 50%) — that is what 「各产生 1 次」 says. ⚠ **Registered**: the same trigger on 「**或施放终结技时**」 — the unit casting the ultimate is the event's *actor*, and `attacker` (the only selector that could name a caster) is defined for damage segments, so attaching a heal to whoever cast an ultimate is a spelling this engine does not have; and the 「强化后」 healing sentence (see the state rule).

source: 1217 藿藿 技能表的**等级口径**: 文档引用的是 Lv10 行（普攻 50%生命上限、战技 21.00%+560、终结技 20%能量/40%攻击力、天赋 4.50%+120 都是该行）
note: The file stating which level its numbers come from (M-32). ⚠ It matters to the **engine's own** Skill heal (a `Restore` skill reads its row). ⚠ **Not classified yet**: 秘技 (a map mechanic plus a battle-start clause not yet read), and 星魂 1–6.

source: 1217 藿藿 秘技 凶煞•劾压鬼物: 「…有100%的基础概率使敌方每个单体目标攻击力降低25%，持续2回合」（param = [1, 0.25, 2, 10] ⇒ 100% / 25% / 2 回合）
note: 「有 **100%** 的<u>基础概率</u>使敌方每个单体目标**攻击力降低 25%**，持续 **2 回合**」—— ① 秘技的入场半句 ⇒ `self has_state 秘技` ✓；② 参数行 **`[1, 0.25, 2, 10]`** 逐项吻合 ✓（100% / 25% / 2 回合 ✓）；③ `ATTACK` 同为**平值属性** ⇒ `percent: -0.25` = 基数的 −25% ✓（与 1106 的 `DEFENCE: -0.2` 同约定 ✓）；④ `base_chance: 1.0` ✓（走命中/抵抗管线 ✓）。
